name: Color Phase
description: A crossfade in which each color channel changes at a different time. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: from_step
params.description: When each channel (r, g, b, a) starts changing, 0 to 1

params.name: to_step
params.description: When each channel (r, g, b, a) finishes changing, 0 to 1 (above `from_step`)
